Hi Redwood team,

I signed up for a trial from the GitHub open-source listing and wanted to see a quick live demo focused on using Redwood with our CI: we run a lot of builds on self-hosted runners and are evaluating whether Redwood can run inference in CI for codegen/QA steps.

Would love a 30-min slot next week. I’m PST (San Francisco).

Thanks,
Alex Garcia

Subject: Confirmed: Redwood demo Tue 05/05 10:00 PST — agenda + quick answers

Hi Alex / Carol — thanks for booking, excited to chat next week. Quick confirmation and a short agenda so the session is productive:

Agenda (30 min):
- 5m: intros + goals
- 10m: demo — Redwood in a CI workflow (codegen -> QA checks)
- 10m: architecture and integration patterns for self-hosted runners
- 5m: next steps (pilot, security docs, POC checklist)

Quick answers to the questions in your email:
- Example Action: we have a concise example that uses a least-privilege short-lived token pattern and a small helper script. I attached the ops note and a one-page Arch diagram to this message.
- Self-hosted runners: recommended pattern depends on tolerance for egress and latency. For sensitive repos we typically recommend Redwood Private (VPC) so traffic never leaves customer-controlled networks; for hybrid teams a reverse-proxy with token scoping is a lower-touch option but requires secure secret distribution. We’ll walk through tradeoffs in the call.
- Token scopes: use an API key scoped to inference-only actions and rotate regularly; if using GitHub Actions, the Action should call a small internal service (token vault) which mints short-lived tokens for the runner, rather than embedding long-lived secrets in workflows.

Attachments: redwood-integration-ops.pdf (ops note, examples), mvp-arch.png (reference arch)

Joining: Jonas (SDR), Marissa (Integrations Eng), Rishi (Solutions Architect).

If you want us to send the sample Action ahead of time to Carol, we can — say the word and Marissa will follow up with the gist.

See you Tue 10:00 PST — invite shows on your calendar.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Solutions SDR, Redwood Inference
